summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K to announce an expansion in its global deployment footprint across U.S. government, international, and research customers. The press release details an increase from a single PowerBuoy deployment to five concurrent systems in the U.S., including support for the Department of Homeland Security and Department of War, plus international deployments of WAM-V autonomous surface vehicles and PowerBuoys in the UAE and Taiwan. No financial terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are provided. This is a routine operational update on product deployments, not a special situation transaction. There are no deal terms to watch.
